messages.subject: Read data for QTL experiment
parts:
Hi,

this is what i run in R

corndata <- read.cross("mm", dir="C:\\Users\\pc\\Desktop\\corn sp", file="T.raw",
mapfile="T.MAP")

then, i received an error message

Error in read.cross.mm(dir, file, mapfile, estimate.map) :
Cannot find markers in genotype data: rga01_1 rga01_2 rga01_3 rga06_1 rga06_2 rga06_3.

what does this mean? do i have to manipulate, edit or remove the missing markers?

please help ASAP. thank you so much!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Read data for QTL experiment
parts:
It seems that we require the marker in the map file to match those in the genotypes, so try deleting those markers from the map.

karl
